title: 7 Proverbs a Godly Man Turns on Himself First
caption:
Most men run this backwards. Soft on their own sin, sharp with the guy across the table.

Proverbs never lets a man get away with that split. Search your own depths before you search his. Question your own motives before you question his. Hold your verdict until you've actually heard him out. The book keeps turning the questions back on the one asking them.

"Whoever belittles his neighbor lacks sense, but a man of understanding stays silent." Proverbs 11:12. Run that standard on yourself before you ever run it on him.

#faith #proverbs #christianmen #manofgod #humility
theme: He's hard on himself, gentle with others.
